z3_encoding_notes: Use floor_div(a, b) to represent Solidity integer division a / b which truncates towards zero for positive numbers.
The constant 1 ether (10^18) is represented as 1000000000000000000.
The gap condition (debt - creditLimit) requires careful handling of underflow; since debt > creditLimit is a precondition, the gap is strictly positive before liquidation.

The core vulnerability stems from the fact that the collateral removed (liquidatorReward + liquidationFee) reduces the credit limit by collateralFactorBps/10000 of its value, while the debt is reduced by 1x its value. If the collateral removed is worth more than 10000/collateralFactorBps times the debt repaid, the gap increases.

The value of collateral removed in debt terms is (liquidatorReward + liquidationFee) * price / 1 ether. Substituting the formulas yields repaidDebt * (10000 + liquidationIncentiveBps + liquidationFeeBps) / 10000. The gap decreases iff repaidDebt > (collateral_removed_value * collateralFactorBps / 10000), which simplifies to collateralFactorBps * (10000 + liquidationIncentiveBps + liquidationFeeBps) < 10000^2.
